notes: Compound heterozygous candidate in BUB1B (MVA1, autosomal recessive): stop_gained p.Leu737Ter (c.2210T>G) + missense p.Asn1002Lys (c.3006T>G). Both PASS, balanced allele depth, rare/absent in gnomAD. Phase (trans vs. cis) not confirmed - proband-only WGS, loci ~11kb apart (beyond short-read insert size).

Heterozygous frameshift in GINS1 (c.278del, p.Ser93PhefsTer6), an autosomal-recessive growth-restriction gene in the same clinical differential as BUB1B. No second rare variant found in GINS1, so reported as a lower-confidence incidental carrier finding, not a primary call.
